transcript.text: Mitsuri. The report from the village states that seven homes were destroyed by the force of your Love Breathing during the battle. You know our rules about civilian protection. Why did you act with such force?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Your apology is noted, but it does not answer my question. You are a Hashira, Mitsuri. You have faced powerful demons before without causing such widespread destruction. What was different this time?

I focused on eliminating the threat to the village, but I... I did not anticipate the full force of my technique affecting so many structures. I promise to refine my control and ensure such an incident does not occur again.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: An aura that hindered your movement? That is a new development. Yet, as a Hashira, you are trained to adapt. Did you consider using a different form, or repositioning the battle away from the village?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Oyakata-sama, you are correct. I... I was caught off-guard by the demon's abilities, and I did not respond with the adaptability I should have shown. I was focused on stopping the immediate threat, and... I did not take the necessary steps to protect the village. I have failed in my duties as a Hashira, and I will take this lesson to heart as I train. I must improve my ability to assess and react to unexpected situations.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Your self-awareness is commendable, but it does not change the fact that seven families are now without homes. The Corps exists to protect people, not to leave them homeless in the wake of our battles. What will you do to make amends to those villagers?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Oyakata-sama, I understand the gravity of my actions. I will... I will take it upon myself to provide financial assistance to the affected families. I will also ensure that the necessary resources are available for them to rebuild their homes as quickly as possible. If it is permissible, I would like to personally oversee the reconstruction efforts. This way, I can at least offer some solace to the villagers and demonstrate my commitment to their well-being. I beg your permission to implement this plan, and I will cover all associated costs from my own earnings.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Very well. I will allow you to oversee the reconstruction and provide compensation. But understand this, Mitsuri: your strength is a gift, but it must be wielded with precision. The next time you face a demon, I expect you to remember the faces of those you displaced. Dismissed.
